interpretation: The clean Base 14 and Expanded 47 catalogs are the only canonical Scenario body sources. The v2 audit remains immutable evidence for the 61 entry/recovery classifications and semantic schema. Historical architecture-scenarios is frozen evidence of the extraction that produced the clean Expanded catalog; it is not an ongoing source constraint and canonical Scenario bodies may evolve through normal semantic re-audit without rewriting historical evidence. This v3 binding covers the clean catalogs, immutable historical evidence blob, direct trace, v2 classification audit, and schema digest.
